description: This file defines the Zend_Locale_Math class, which provides mathematical utility functions that proxy to BCMath functions if available, or fallback to PHP's native math functions. It includes methods for rounding, normalization, and localization of numeric values, and manages external dependencies related to BCMath extension.

classes.name: Zend_Locale_Math
classes.description: Utility class for performing math operations with optional BCMath support, including rounding, normalization, and localization.

methods.name: isBcmathDisabled
methods.description: Checks if BCMath functions are disabled.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a number to a specified precision, using BCMath if enabled.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts a number to standard English notation, fixing locale-related issues.

methods.name: localize
methods.description: Converts a number from standard English notation to locale-specific format.
